specification.problem: Approximate a single-qubit z-rotation by a single-qubit circuit over the Pauli+V gate set, using a deterministic-search technique adapted from the Ross-Selinger analysis for Clifford+T. The abstract gives no explicit formulas, so only background definitions can be supplied.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Define the approximation problem for one z-rotation Rz(theta) and precision epsilon, with an assumed tiny instance (theta = pi/8, epsilon = 0.1). Include the standard V-gate definition and the operator-norm error criterion. The deterministic-search algorithm, its geometric construction, and the depth and optimality results are outside this scope.

steps.description: Fix theta and epsilon, with the assumed tiny instance theta = pi/8 and epsilon = 0.1, and form the target R_z(theta).
Fix the Pauli+V gate set and its V-gate convention.
Seek a short word U over the gate set satisfying the error criterion. The deterministic-search method for finding such a word is not specified in the abstract and must be supplied from the source.

The operator-norm error criterion is assumed.
